title: MSK144
short: MSK144 is a Minimum Shift Keying FSK signal used for amateur radio meteor-scatter contacts. It transmits 144 bit long packets at a baudrate of 2000 bps using frequencies 1000 and 2000 Hz.
desc: **MSK144** is a Minimum Shift Keying FSK signal used for amateur radio meteor-scatter contacts. It transmits 144 bit long packets at a baudrate of 2000 bps using frequencies 1000 and 2000 Hz. It is part of the WSJT-X suite, developed by Joe Taylor K1JT and others.
